TRANSPARENT INSPECTION

How PhishShift Works

1

Paste the message

Paste the text content into the scanner. Text is processed exclusively in your device's browser memory. No data is stored, cached, or transmitted to any server.

2

In-browser machine learning

A trained 5,000-feature TF-IDF vectorizer and 100-neuron Multilayer Perceptron neural network execute locally in JavaScript, analyzing syntax, terminology, and semantic weight.

3

Understand & protect

Review calibrated risk classifications, explainable word attribution gradients, and specific threat cues to make an informed, confident safety decision.

Privacy & Safety by Design

Digital communication security requires absolute user privacy. PhishShift operates with strict defensive guardrails.

  • Zero Server Transmission

    All machine learning inference runs 100% locally in your browser. Your messages never leave your machine.

  • Zero URL Execution

    Extracted URLs are treated strictly as inert text strings. The scanner never opens, navigates, or pings any link found in user text.

  • Safe DOM Rendering

    Message content is rendered exclusively through safe textNode and textContent APIs to protect against script injection.

PhishShift Built for safer digital communication.

PhishShift is an educational prototype. Machine-learning models can make mistakes. Always independently verify suspicious requests through official, out-of-band communication channels.
